source: Martin Lings, Muhammad: His Life Based on the Earliest Sources, 1983/1991 editions; chapter titles cross-checked against SDSU Humanities Hub catalogue and a searchable PDF contents. Sample direct readings: XV The First Revelations, XXXI–XXXII Year of Sadness, LXVI–LXVIII Hudaybiyyah. Chapter titles and thematic cues guide original narrative composition, not verbal imitation. Specific historical details require primary hadith/Sīrah verification.
rule: Refer to Lings in research footnotes, never matn or continuous sharh. Use scene selection, narrative pacing and emotionally apt spiritual themes. Do not reproduce copyrighted passages or mistake literary interpretation for independent early witnesses.
